summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026, and a growing set of developer-facing inference platforms (Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow) that make open-weight models easy to run via local tooling or hosted APIs. Download activity is highly concentrated, with roughly half of Hugging Face models having under 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. These hubs and APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and managed MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open access, rapid prototyping, and cost-efficient serverless inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub and community for hosting, sharing, and discovering open-source AI models, datasets, and demo apps (Spaces), plus hosted inference.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and limited inference; Pro at ~$9/mo; Inference Providers (pay-per-use routing to partner APIs); Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise Hub from ~$20/user/mo
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Inference Providers routing to partners (Together, Fireworks, etc.)
Model cards, download stats, and version control via Git LFS
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers wanting the broadest access to open models, datasets, and collaborative tooling.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight tool for running open-weight LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.) plus GGUF imports
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; runs on local hardware (no usage fees); optional Ollama cloud/turbo tiers for hosted compute
features: One-command local model download and run
Modelfile customization and quantized GGUF support
Runs offline with full data privacy
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run and prototype with open models locally without cloud costs.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source and custom models via a simple API, with packaging through the Cog container format.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across text, image, audio, and video
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog open-source tool for packaging models as containers
Strong catalog of image/video generation models
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to integrate or deploy open models (especially generative media) without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs and multimodal models with OpenAI-compatible APIs.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; dedicated GPU endpoints billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token/job
features: Fast serverless inference optimized with custom kernels
Broad open-model catalog including image models
Batch inference and JSON/structured output modes
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams building production apps on open models who need scalable, low-latency inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-focused serverless inference platform for open-weight LLMs, vision, and audio models aimed at production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning fees
features: Function calling and structured output (JSON mode)
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model hosting
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing inference speed, cost efficiency, and compliance for open-model deployments.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong presence in Asia) providing fast, affordable access to a wide range of open-source LLMs and generative models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, FLUX, GLM, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage-based pricing, often low-cost; free credits for some models; dedicated deployments available
features: Competitive pricing with free tiers for select models
Text, image, audio, and video generation support
Strong support for Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asian markets) seeking low-cost, high-variety access to leading open and Chinese-origin models.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware for running open LLMs at very high token speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mixtral, DeepSeek distills, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing with a free developer tier; enterprise/dedicated options
features: Industry-leading inference speed via LPU hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing plus a small platform fee; prepaid credits; no subscription
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and load balancing across providers
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
No vendor lock-in with easy provider switching
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a wide range of models through one integration.
